name: thesis_commit
title: Commit a verifiable market thesis
description: Tamper-evident commitment of an agent's reasoning BEFORE the market moves. Given a symbol, a natural-language thesis, and optional conviction/horizon/evidence references, returns a sha256 commitment plus a hash-chained ledger receipt proving the thesis existed at commit time. Later, anyone can recompute the chain to confirm the thesis was not written after the fact — 'early, not wrong' as a platform primitive. The same append-only ledger carries the caller's theses and the practice agent's decisions, so a single chain audit covers both.

symbol.description: Ticker the thesis covers (max 14 chars), e.g. 'HYPE'.

horizon_hours.description: Optional resolution window in hours — after it, the thesis is checkable against outcome.

evidence_refs.description: Optional digests/URIs of the evidence used (e.g. 'analyze_token:rest:693f8d49b2ae').

commitment.description: sha256 over the canonical thesis payload — cite this.

implementation.http: POST /ryo/thesis-commit (agent/ryo/serve.ts, or mount on RYO's MCP surface)

safety.network: none required (anchoring optional via anchorAll env-gating)
